memberships.page_title: Boundary Jets and Stable Moduli in the Cubic Frame

statement: The boundary-data quotient B_N=[U_N/G_m] is a smooth Deligne-Mumford stack of dimension 2N-1 whose geometric points classify coprime admissible cubic-frame maps of boundary length N; it is a framed or rigidified boundary stack, not the full unrigidified left-right groupoid.
